summary: Frontend-only rhythm-room review. Tested all three modes at 12 requested viewports and cadet/pro/master; completed five-round sessions, restart and return-to-modes in every mode at 568x260. Stew's enlarged tight crop is intact in all eight frames; desktop/landscape side-by-side layout and outer gameplay bounds pass. Confirmed unreadable/clipped short-screen Beat Finder notation, fullscreen-button obstruction, and automatic Copy session-score undercount. No app code changed.

ui_bugs.issue: At 568x260, all three selectable strips fit externally but their contents do not: cadet note images measure approximately 3.1x8px, blocks are only 21.3px tall, and every syllable extends below its overflow-hidden block. Master screenshot is also unreadable. This undermines the core find-the-matching-pattern task.

At 568x260, the bottom-right fullscreen button overlays the second and third Beat Finder strips, hiding notes and intercepting their tap area. Measured overlaps: 704px² and 1312px². Also visible over the lower strip in the master screenshot. The compact layout reserves no space for this global floating control.

After playing round five and allowing automatic advance, the live header score was 348 but session-final-score was 338. Manual next-round/session buttons completed correctly in separate sessions. Automatic summary reads a captured score before final queued score updates.

issues: The long header marquee artwork crowds/extends toward the score badge; the wrapper bounds fit but the inner title pill is visually cramped. Consider a compact portrait title.

Copy/Trail instruction Start initially sits partly below the screen (Copy y540..584 at height568). The card is scrollable and an actual Start click succeeded after automatic internal scrolling; not a blocking bug.
Difficulty and tempo wrap to two rows; the picker scrollHeight is 283 for a 260px viewport, so the session-length blurb is below the fold. All mode/difficulty/tempo buttons fit after layout settles.

action_items: Give compact Beat Finder rows enough inner height for readable note art and complete syllables; do not merely fit their outer boxes.
Move or reserve space for the global fullscreen button on this route so no strips/timing/tap targets are obscured.
Use the latest committed score for automatic Copy/Trail session summaries, including the last tap, rest reward and round bonus; retest both manual and automatic advance.
Perform real iPhone Safari testing with URL/tool bars and safe-area insets after fixes. WebKit was unavailable in this environment.
Optionally compact the narrow portrait marquee and fit the shortest picker blurb without scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: BoomGardenPage.css compact match rules flex three rows into the remaining height with min-height:0; RhythmStrip's image maxHeight:60%, label and padding then exceed the inner block height, and overflow-hidden masks the labels. Parent-only overflow checks miss this.

finishCopyRound stores captured score in its automatic sessionStats callback (BoomGardenPage.js lines519-527). Score updates in the final tap/rest/bonus are asynchronous, so the captured value can be stale. Trail shares this function; its automatic final score was not independently compared.
The live header score has no data-testid, requiring a scoped CSS fallback for the score comparison.
BoomGardenPage.js is 1886 lines, exceeding the 700-line maintainability guideline; extract session/scoring logic and overlays when refactoring.

success_rate.frontend: 15/15 session rounds completed; 3/3 restart/back flows passed; 108/108 outer gameplay-bound checks passed; 8/8 sprite crops intact. Three confirmed bugs remain; outer bounds alone are not visual acceptance.

seed_data_creation: Only localStorage jma_unlock_all_v1='1', jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1', jma_reveal_seen_v1='1'. Existing progress/accounts are browser-local (MOCKED backend integration); no backend/accounts/payments tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL read from frontend/.env. Tested desktop 1920x800,1440x900,1366x768,1024x768; short landscape 844x390,844x300,812x290,667x275,568x260; portrait 320x568,390x844; tablet768x1024. Chromium context has touch enabled. Initial smoke timeout was caused by forcing the mode click while the audio overlay still intercepted it: explicitly click audio-unlock-overlay and wait until hidden. Audio unlock requests fullscreen; exit fullscreen before automated viewport changes. Genuine entry passes. The hook responds to visualViewport resize: overriding visible height to290 with layout844x390 updates room height to290. Portrait/landscape changes during active Copy round retained the layout. No FitStage on route. Keyboard hold gives one animation, pointer/space/blank-field taps each increment hits; Stew crop bounds stayed exactly x69.14,y94,w128.11,h168 across countin/input at844x300. Actual rendered crop, not padded PNG bounds, was used. All three match options selected across sessions; replay clicked. No error text found using prescribed selectors. Normal emulation cannot replicate Safari browser chrome; WebKit executable /pw-browsers/webkit-2370/pw_run.sh missing. Audible output and every streak milestone were not exhaustively verified. Screenshots are under test_reports/screens/boom_*; gameplay desktop and short-screen, countin and session overlays were visually reviewed. Expected sprite image scrollWidth overflow is transparent-padding crop, NOT a gameplay bug. Initial test logs also contain corrected harness failures (fullscreen resize and transition waits); final sessions completed successfully.
rca of the issue: Confirmed visual failures arise from shrinking Beat Finder row internals below their content's minimum readable height and from an unrelated global fixed fullscreen control not included in this route's layout budget. Score mismatch arises from captured React score state in automatic session advance. Reproduce with test_boom_details.py and test_boom_auto_score.py. App fixes were intentionally left to the main agent.
